study_role: Frozen single-replicate 1% summary-compression extension; no manuscript edits
summary_length_repair: Preserve valid members; iterative individual measured-length repair, followed by a plain concise-summary prompt; Kimi-K3 is used only for persistent invalid summaries. All outputs must pass the same 55% limit; no probes or answers
constraints: Freeze existing ownership units, carrier texts, probes and owner-side clusters; no new construction or selection on target results
Summarize every ordinary and carrier document after injection using one blind rule; never supply probes, answers, method names or carrier status
RAG-WM is appended to original documents before whole-document summarization, never appended after summarization
Summary batches are content-hash sorted, identical texts share identical transformations across methods
Use the already frozen topic assignment and retained topics, not summary-dependent or method-specific reclustering
Summary rule follows the old 55% word-count policy but generates summaries only, rather than also generating paraphrases
RAG-WM uses the original relation oracle; SentinelRAG and RAVET use expected-answer correctness
Common decision p0 is calibrated on evaluation-disjoint summarized clean documents, not positive target outcomes
RAVET causal replay uses observed answer prefixes only; scheduler p0 stays at the previously frozen 0.15
Thirty distinct-unit answers are acquired offline; report simulated deployment-query cost separately from acquisition and preprocessing calls
Random-order seeds are averaged within a deployment, not treated as independent deployments
Observed clean FPR and empirical calibration do not establish a conditional-null guarantee for adaptive stopping
Match 30 evidence identities, not identical carrier-document or token overhead; keep RAG-WM transfer limitations explicit
API errors and malformed/truncated outputs are missing, never negative outcomes; no manuscript edits
